# Native build dependencies

`dependencies.lock` records the pinned NCNN and Vulkan-Headers revisions used
by the native build. Fetched source trees are local build inputs; they are not
runtime files. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for setup and update
instructions, and [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for
attributions and license requirements.
